messages:
Alyssa (CS): Quick async standup for Citrine/HelixHealth — renewal signed last week but adoption telemetry is dipping after webhook failures. High level: customer sees retries & duplicate events, some 429/502 errors.
Morgan (CS): What I did yesterday: ran logs & traced request spikes to our ingress layer. Flagged several 502s originating from backend timeouts. Blockers: need eng to verify retry/idempotency behavior and confirm whether duplicates hit downstream.
Sanjay (Eng): On it. I pulled the traces — spike around 2026-03-15T10:02Z, coincides with their scheduled bulk sync. Suspect worker pool saturation + short backend timeouts. Plan: temporarily increase webhook-workers, add better backoff, and validate idempotency checks.
Jamie (Solutions): Heads-up — paused Citrine automated nightly syncs to reduce pressure. Sent a short FYI to the customer and offered a temporary rate bump. :thumbsup:
Sanjay (Eng): Quick ask — can someone paste a redacted failing payload and headers so I can reproduce locally (request-id, idempotency key preferred)?
Alyssa (CS): Sample headers + payload (redacted):
```json
{"headers":{"x-request-id":"req-789-redacted","idempotency-key":"abc-123-redacted"},"body":{"event":"user.update","user":{"id":"redacted_user_42"}}}
```
Morgan (CS): Workaround deployed: paused scheduled syncs and routed traffic for org `citrine-helix` to a dedicated pool. Monitoring now — error rate dropping but not zero.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled scale-up of webhook-workers by +3 instances (auto-scaler override), ETA ~5m.
Sanjay (Eng): I'll open a small PR to add explicit idempotency check and jittered exponential backoff — PR #4123. Requesting reviews from @Jamie and @Morgan. Target: canary deploy today EOD.
Jamie (Solutions): I'll review PR this afternoon. Customer communication: offered temporary rate bump and promised RCA and timeline.
Alyssa (CS): CS blockers: need eng confirmation whether retry could cause permanent duplicates in downstream systems and what compensating actions look like. Also need a short rollback plan if canary regresses.
Sanjay (Eng): Canary plan: add header `x-helix-canary:true`, validate idempotency before processing, and emit `x-request-id` in logs. If duplication occurs, we'll run a dedupe job using (user_id + event_timestamp) as canonical key.
Morgan (CS): Scheduling a 1:1 with the customer at 15:00 PT to set expectations and confirm whether they want logs for specific request ids. I'll post follow-up notes here.
Alyssa (CS): Thanks — I'll update this thread after the 3pm call with customer asks and any additional examples. :handshake:
